# Sector — firsthand Czech localization report

- Original source: [Sector — firsthand Czech localization report](https://www.sector.sk/novinka/14808/robin-hood-cz-look.htm)
- Author / publication: saver / Sector.sk
- Language / date: Slovak; 2003-02-17
- Access: Indexed article text inspected; direct retrieval failed
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The writer reports having inspected the Czech edition and praises the dubbed introduction, character voices, translated text, and scrolls. The short report recommends the game particularly to readers who found Commandos or Desperados too difficult.

This is useful firsthand evidence about the localization actually encountered, rather than an announcement of a future translation. The page also advertises screenshots of that edition; those images were not visually inspected here. Its historical shop price is not a current offer.

# Robin Hood CZ look  
  
---|---  
  
## 

pridal [saver](/redaktor/saver.htm) 17.2.2003 o 18:54 pod hry

HRY > NOVINKY >

  

Práve som si pozrel **Robina Hooda Legendu Sherwoodu** v českej verzií a musím povedať že čeština je tam naozaj kvalitná. Super nadabované je titulné intro a aj hlasy jednotlivých postáv počas hry, síce v hre sú to už len výkriky, ako _Do střehu_ a podobné, ale znie to celkom dobre a dobre to dopĺňa preloženie všetky textov a hlavne zvitkov. Určite hru odporúčam všetkým fanúšikom Commandos, alebo Desperados a hlavne tým ktorým sa tieto hry zdali ťažké. Recenziu [nájdete tu](http://www.sector.sk/clanok.asp?id=6363) a hru [môžete kúpiť tu](http://shop.sector.sk/detail.aspx?co=1&id=2645) za 1290 Sk. Tu je pár shotov z českej verzie:

  
  
  
  

[ ](//imgs.sector.sk/files/novinky/20032171854/snap0000083.jpg "Robin Hood CZ look ") [ ](//imgs.sector.sk/files/novinky/20032171854/snap0000084.jpg "Robin Hood CZ look ") [ ](//imgs.sector.sk/files/novinky/20032171854/3.jpg "Robin Hood CZ look ")

Páči sa mi!
